title: Efficacy of Interleukin-2 Gargle in the Treatment of Oral Mucosa Lesion in Pemphigus Vulgaris
brief_summary: This clinical study will test the short-term efficacy of interleukin-2 gargle combined with systemic use of glucocorticoids in the treatment of oral mucosal lesions in mucosal-dominant pemphigus vulgaris and moderate mucocutaneous pemphigus vulgaris.
